Goblin.about: Goblins are cunning merchants and inventors, and the best of them sell to everyone.

ZandalariTroll.about: The Zandalari are the oldest of the trolls, proud keepers of their gods and their empire.

Worgen.about: Cursed people of Gilneas who keep their minds in the shape of a wolf.

KulTiran.about: Sturdy sailors of the island kingdom of Kul Tiras.

Vulpera.about: Small desert foxes, scavengers and travellers who make a home wherever their caravan stops.

Pandaren.about: Wanderers from the Wandering Isle who seek balance - and good food.

HighElf.about: The quel'dorei who stayed true to the Alliance after the fall of Quel'Thalas.

FelOrc.about: Orcs who drank the blood of demons, and kept its fury.

Broken.about: Draenei changed by the fel magic of the orcs, who still remember who they were.

Earthen.about: Living stone shaped by the titans, the forefathers of the dwarves.

DrakkariTroll.about: The ice trolls of Zul'Drak, an empire that fell to the Scourge.

Vrykul.about: Giant warriors of Northrend, made by the titans and fond of battle.

Tuskarr.about: Fishers and hunters of the Northrend coasts, friendly to all who come in peace.

Taunka.about: The northern cousins of the tauren, hardened by the cold of Northrend.

ForestTroll.about: The trolls of the forests of Lordaeron and the Hinterlands.

IceTroll.about: The trolls of the frozen north, tough as the ice they live on.

Skeleton.about: Bones that walk on their own, free of the Lich King.

Naga.about: Serpent people of the deep sea, once night elves of Zin-Azshari.

NorthrendSkeleton.about: The bones of Northrend, risen in the cold and left without a master.

LeperTroll.about: Trolls marked by a wasting sickness, and the harder for it.

Troglodyte.about: Cave dwellers of the deep places of the world.

ThinHuman.about: A lean folk of humans, quick and wiry.

HumanCultist.about: Humans who gave themselves to dark powers - and lived to tell of it.
